metaTitle: Custom Clear Badge ID Holders | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom clear badge ID holders in bulk. Perfect for events, offices, and tradeshows. Get your quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Clear badge ID holders offer a professional, unobtrusive look that works with any uniform or dress code. Unlike colored holders, clear lets your logo and employee photos stand out without visual interference. They are ideal for tradeshows, corporate events, and daily office use where a clean, consistent appearance matters. Decorate with screen printing or debossing for a subtle brand presence.
